title: Switching the alarm system by call
body_md: In the operating modes provided for it, the connected alarm system can be switched to its next state by a call. Call Pro-finder to do so. The device ends the call automatically before a chargeable connection is established and sends a status report to the caller after successful switching.
prev_context: Chapter 4 ends on the previous page.
